name: visual-review
description: Create self-contained interactive HTML dashboards for deep code reviews

interface.shortDescription: Build interactive code reviews with diagrams
interface.longDescription: Deeply review pull requests and render correctness and safe-to-merge scores, interactive diagrams, structured evidence, API manifests, expandable full-context diffs, and fix prompts in one portable HTML dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Use $visual-review to deeply review this pull request and create an interactive HTML dashboard.
